# service_wire

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Public service envelope and observation values; the first v1alpha2 binding is served and read, no persisted entity.

`connectors.service_wire` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `AttemptReference`

`connectors.service_wire.AttemptReference` is a record of two fields:

- `instance` — `String`
- `id` — `connectors.mutations.AttemptId`

### `AuditStatus`

`connectors.service_wire.AuditStatus` is one of `complete`, `incomplete`, `unavailable` and `not_required`.

### `AuthAlternative`

`connectors.service_wire.AuthAlternative` is a record of two fields:

- `profile` — `String`
- `scopes` — `List<String>`

### `BaseErrorCode`

`connectors.service_wire.BaseErrorCode` is one of `invalid_input`, `unsupported`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `stale_description`, `stale_cursor`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable`, `capacity`, `timeout`, `upstream_protocol` and `internal`.

### `CauseStage`

`connectors.service_wire.CauseStage` is one of `preflight`, `attempt_store`, `approval`, `dispatch`, `response`, `observation` and `audit`.

### `DiagnosticCause`

`connectors.service_wire.DiagnosticCause` is a record of two fields:

- `code` — `connectors.service_wire.BaseErrorCode`
- `stage` — `connectors.service_wire.CauseStage`

### `Error`

`connectors.service_wire.Error` is a record of three fields:

- `code` — `connectors.service_wire.ErrorCode`
- `message` — `String`
- `retry_after_seconds` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent

### `ErrorCode`

`connectors.service_wire.ErrorCode` is one of `invalid_input`, `unsupported`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `stale_description`, `stale_cursor`, `rate_limited`, `unavailable`, `capacity`, `timeout`, `upstream_protocol`, `internal`, `approval_required`, `approval_refused`, `approval_replayed`, `idempotency_conflict`, `outcome_unknown`, `not_granted`, `stale_authority`, `connection_not_ready`, `route_unavailable`, `route_refused`, `insufficient_scope`, `session_not_ready`, `session_lost`, `offer_expired`, `offer_rejected`, `lease_expired` and `revoked`.

### `InvokeRequest`

`connectors.service_wire.InvokeRequest` is a record of five fields:

- `version` — `String`
- `request_id` — `String`
- `operation` — `String`
- `revision` — `String`
- `input` — `Json`

### `InvokeResponse`

`connectors.service_wire.InvokeResponse` is a record of nine fields:

- `version` — `connectors.service_wire.Version`
- `request_id` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `status` — `connectors.service_wire.ResponseStatus`
- `result` — `Optional<Json>`, which may be absent
- `error` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.Error>`, which may be absent
- `audit_ref` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `audit_status` — `connectors.service_wire.AuditStatus`
- `source_audit` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.SourceAudit>`, which may be absent
- `mutation` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.MutationObservation>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `version == v1alpha2`, `((status == success and defined(result) and not (defined(error))) or (status == error and defined(error) and not (defined(result))))`, `((audit_status == complete and defined(audit_ref)) or (audit_status == incomplete and defined(audit_ref)) or (audit_status == unavailable and not (defined(audit_ref))) or (audit_status == not_required and not (defined(audit_ref))))` and `(status != success or not (defined(mutation)) or mutation.classification == applied)`.

### `MutationObservation`

`connectors.service_wire.MutationObservation` is a record of five fields:

- `classification` — `connectors.mutations.EffectKnowledge`
- `attempt` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.AttemptReference>`, which may be absent
- `original_request_id` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `replayed` — `Boolean`
- `cause` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.DiagnosticCause>`, which may be absent

### `OperationLimits`

`connectors.service_wire.OperationLimits` is a record of five fields:

- `request_bytes` — `Integer`
- `result_bytes` — `Integer`
- `execution_ms` — `Integer`
- `provider_ms` — `Integer`
- `connect_ms` — `Integer`

### `ResponseStatus`

`connectors.service_wire.ResponseStatus` is one of `success` and `error`.

### `SourceAudit`

`connectors.service_wire.SourceAudit` is a record of three fields:

- `instance` — `String`
- `audit_ref` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `audit_status` — `connectors.service_wire.AuditStatus`

### `Version`

`connectors.service_wire.Version` is one of `v1alpha1` and `v1alpha2`.

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.service_wire.AuthAlternative`, `connectors.service_wire.InvokeRequest`, `connectors.service_wire.InvokeResponse` and `connectors.service_wire.OperationLimits`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
